text:
Which statement about evaporation is correct?
A
Evaporation causes the temperature of the remaining liquid to decrease.
B
Evaporation does not occur from a cold liquid near its freezing point.
C
Evaporation does not occur from a dense liquid, such as mercury.
D
Evaporation occurs from all parts of a liquid.

options.label: A
options.text: Evaporation causes the temperature of the remaining liquid to decrease.

options.label: B
options.text: Evaporation does not occur from a cold liquid near its freezing point.

options.label: C
options.text: Evaporation does not occur from a dense liquid, such as mercury.

options.label: D
